Got a refund, but never going back. If you want clean, premium cakes, try:

We sincerely apologize for your experience and are truly sorry to hear about what happened during such an important occasion for your father’s birthday. Finding a hair in the cake and feeling that your concerns were not handled appropriately is not the experience we want any customer to have.

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We appreciate your feedback and regret that we could not meet your expectations on this occasion.

Finally, we were told that the price was higher because we selected cookies of our own choice instead of the pre-decided assortment. So we asked them to make the box according to their standard selection instead, but by then they said, “Bill generate ho gaya, ab change nahi kar sakte.”

The entire interaction felt unprofessional and poorly handled. The staff was inattentive, clueless about the pricing structure, and even the manager was not available at outlet  and was speaking to us over a phone call.

This was genuinely the first time we have walked out of a place without buying anything. There was simply no point continuing the discussion.
